messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Spike in errors and tail latency for requests routed from eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. Affected service: prod/global-api. AlertID=RTE-8472. Please acknowledge.

jordan: Acknowledged. Seeing ~3x latency and some 5xx/504s in the EU->US paths on the perf dashboard.

maya: I'm oncall, taking this. @neteng can you check if there were any routing/operator changes in the last 10m?

neteng: No infra maintenance. We do see a policy operator event promoting `route-policy:geo-v2` around the same time. Metrics show weights flipped for eu-west1 -> us-east1 traffic.

patrick: I'm starting a rollback to geo-v1 per runbook (quick rollback path). Will post the command.

patrick: ```
# rollback geo routing policy
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/policy/rollback \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"policy":"geo-v2","target":"geo-v1","reason":"weight-flip-regression"}'
```

ops-bot: :gear: rollback job j-98321 started by patrick (policy rollback: geo-v2 -> geo-v1).

jordan: Customer-ops: top EU customers report timeouts/504s, bumping to P1 for visibility.

customer-ops: Noted, sending an initial customer-facing update to impacted accounts. Draft posted to #incidents-customer-updates.

maya: I'm going to force an edge cache invalidation for EU egress and reduce steering TTL to 30s to accelerate convergence. @neteng please push TTL change.

neteng: TTL for geo steer reduced to 30s and cache invalidation triggered for eu-west1 edge. Policy weights show back to pre-rollout values now.

jordan: Quick log sample showing symptom:
```
level=error component=router upstream=geo-steer response_code=504 resp_time_ms=2300 route=eu->us target=us-east-1
```

ops-bot: rollback job j-98321 completed successfully at 1766789200. Policy state: geo-v1.

maya: Latency profiles are trending back to baseline for most EU clients. A few high tail requests remain; continuing to monitor for 30m.

patrick: Root cause looks like an off-by-one in the promotion script that flipped weights during canary evaluation. Filing MR to add explicit canary gating and automated verification.

customer-ops: Update sent to customers: "We identified a routing configuration change that temporarily increased latency for some EU requests. We rolled back the change and performance is recovering. We're following up with a postmortem." Receiving a few replies.

maya: Handing off monitoring to jordan for the next 30m and scheduling a postmortem meeting with @patrick and @neteng. Please capture timeline + config diffs.

jordan: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep the watch and add notes to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident RTE-8472 status -> mitigated. Follow-up task INC-1729 created (owner=patrick).
